newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: G10 growth prospects positive - Tietmeyer.
newsitem.headline: G10 growth prospects positive - Tietmeyer.

text.p: Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer said Group of 10 (G10) central bank governors believed global economic growth was continuing.
"There seems to be further improvement in worldwide growth levels," Tietmeyer said after chairing a monthly meeting of the G10 central bank governors at the Bank for International Settlements.
In a brief statement on the economic outlook as discussed by the G10 governors, Tietmeyer said the U.S. economy remained on a "positive path".
The United Kingdom and Canada were also doing well economically, he added.
"In Japan there now seems to be a chance for new picking up after some slowing which had been expected," Tietmeyer also told reporters.

Tietmeyer said continental Europe was also expected to experience continued growth, which would be especially strong in some countries, particularly the Netherlands. He did not elaborate. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
